:::{#lem-sample-space-event}
#### The sample space is an event

[The sample space](#def-sample-space) $\samplespace$ is an [event](#def-event).

:::

::: proof

The sample space is a subset of itself, $\samplespace \subseteq \samplespace$.
When every subset of $\samplespace$ can be an event,
that is enough.
Otherwise the events are the subsets in a
[$\sigma$-algebra](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures.html#def-sigma-algebra) $\salg$ on $\samplespace$,
and by its definition $\salg$ contains $\samplespace$ itself.

:::
